{{subpage}}

{{For|the location and structure of this table|Actor Overlay Table}}

== Legend ==

* '''ID:''' Actor's 4 digit hex ID. (Not included in the actual overlay table.)
* '''Filename:''' Actor's filename. (Not included in the actual overlay table.)
* '''VROM:''' Start and end address of actor file in VROM.
* '''VRAM:''' Start and end address of actor file in VRAM.
* '''File RAM:''' Start address of actor file in RAM. (Always zero outside of gameplay.)
* '''Init.:''' Start address of the actor's initialization variables in VRAM. (Located within the actor file.)
* '''Name RAM:''' Start address of actor filename in RAM.
* '''Allo.:''' Actor's allocation type. See [[Actor Overlay Table]] for details.
* '''#:''' Number of instances of this actor currently loaded. (Always zero outside of gameplay.)
* '''*:''' Seemingly unused byte. Always zero.
